checks.description: Only header is a button; explicit label overrides title, null title warns without label, caller accessibility state merges with expanded; both icons remain decorative.

limitations: Unit presses are synthetic and do not establish native dispatch, keyboard timing, focus or screen-reader conformance.
Native, visual and assistive-technology observations are deliberately unlinked; no reviewed execution records were available in this review.
